evals.name: flaky-checkout
evals.expected_output: An ambition ladder that climbs from 'make the test pass' to keeping checkout/CI reliable for good, finds the real bug (forEach(async) not awaited) rather than tuning the sleep, sets a hard measurable target (e.g. 0 failures in N repeated runs), names an outside judge the model can run (repeated test runs / stress loop), and lists any access it would need.

Tests an assumption: names a belief embedded in the request or the team's framing and says how the evidence tests it (or already tests it)
